js.files.note.live: You are editing the live release `{id}`: each save changes the site at once. To keep a way back, duplicate it first.
js.files.note.notLive: Release `{id}` is not live: visitors see nothing you change here until you make it live.
js.files.note.edited: Its files were last changed by {name}, {time}.
js.files.unsavedCount.one: {count} file has edits that are not saved yet.
js.files.unsavedCount.other: {count} files have edits that are not saved yet.
js.files.switchConfirm: Open release {id}? Edits you have not saved will be lost.
js.files.makeLiveConfirm: Make release {id} live on {domain}? Visitors get it at once. The release that is live now stays on the Releases tab.
js.files.loadFailed: The files could not be loaded.
js.files.signedOut: You are signed out. Sign in again, then reload this page.
js.files.offline: The server could not be reached. Check your connection and try again.
js.files.noRelease: This site has no release yet. Create a file or upload some: they become its first release, live at once.
js.files.noFiles: This release has no files. Create a file or upload some.
js.files.moreMatches.one: {count} more file matches. Type more of the name to find it.
js.files.moreMatches.other: {count} more files match. Type more of the name to find them.
js.files.choose: Choose a file to see it here.
js.files.goneElsewhere: Someone else removed {path}. Your edits here are not saved yet: save them to add the file again.
js.files.config.headers: `_headers` holds header rules that come with the release. Rules saved on the Routing tab run after these, so they win.
js.files.config.redirects: `_redirects` holds redirects and rewrites that come with the release. Rules saved on the Routing tab are matched first.
js.files.config.variables: `_variables.json` declares the variables the release reads. A secret's default is never shown here, and a secret declared with no default keeps the one it has. Set a secret's value on the App tab.
js.files.tooLargeToEdit: This file is larger than {size}, so it cannot be edited here. Download it, or upload a new version.
js.files.binary: This file is not text, so it cannot be edited here. Download it, or upload a new version.
js.files.readFailed: The file could not be read. Reload the page and try again.
js.files.editorOffline: The code editor could not load, so this is a plain text box. Your changes save the same way.
js.files.compareLegend: Red lines are the live file's, green lines are yours. You can still edit yours here.
js.files.compareSavedLegend: Red lines are what is saved, green lines are your edits that are not saved yet. You can still edit them here.
js.files.savedElsewhere: Saved {path} in release {id}, the release it was opened from, which is no longer the one open here.
js.files.revertConfirm: Undo the edits to {path} that are not saved yet?
js.files.deleteLiveConfirm: Delete {path} from the live site? Visitors stop getting it at once. Only a copy of the release made earlier can bring it back.
js.files.deleteConfirm: Delete {path} from release {id}? This cannot be undone.
js.files.deleteFolderLiveConfirm.one: Delete the folder {path} and its {count} file from the live site? Visitors stop getting it at once. Only a copy of the release made earlier can bring it back.
js.files.deleteFolderLiveConfirm.other: Delete the folder {path} and its {count} files from the live site? Visitors stop getting them at once. Only a copy of the release made earlier can bring them back.
js.files.deleteFolderConfirm.one: Delete the folder {path} and its {count} file from release {id}? This cannot be undone.
js.files.deleteFolderConfirm.other: Delete the folder {path} and its {count} files from release {id}? This cannot be undone.
js.files.newPath: Path of the new file, such as blog/post.html
js.files.replaceConfirm.one: {count} file already exists and will be replaced: {paths}. Continue?
js.files.replaceConfirm.other: {count} files already exist and will be replaced: {paths}. Continue?
